'''Kelo Poy''' was a being who, on paper, was a major investor in the [[Dropview cantina]]. In reality, a criminal organization called the [[Whitescar Syndicate]] funded the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="CotG">''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]''</ref>
